name: r5 monthly system — halfgate trend-ballast
selected: 2026-09-01 (declared); 2026-09-05 (screened bundle added); 2026-09-06 (generated bundle replaced it); 2026-09-11 (the clean nominal line replaces the split-leak bundle: features [], price_basis nominal, delist_labels last_print); 2026-09-12 (Stage E of the clean program: the sector-centred 4-week label on an 8-year window, book 10 / halfgate / no stop / no cap — reports/clean_improvement.md)
provenance: Stage E package of the clean-improvement program (reports/clean_improvement_registration.md, reports/clean_improvement.md; ledger stage_e_ls_w8_k16), adopted 2026-09-12. Model: the clean line's features and fit, trained on label_4w_sector (the stock's 4-week return minus its sector's same-week median) over a trailing 8-year window — the argmax of stage C (K=4, every week of 2006-2015, top-6 cost-adjusted compounded %/yr: ls_w8 +7.57 vs the incumbent +5.44, paired t +0.95 reported not gated; stage B's sampled sweep only ranked the candidates). Strategy: the procedure's own decision on the K=16 walk of 2006-2015 (the `procedure` block: book 10 by %/yr 8.11 vs 7.86 / 2.14; halfgate by Sharpe .532 vs 60/40 .514, 70/30 .496, 80/20 .48, none .455; no stop .532 vs .482; no cap .532 vs .523). Record, K=16, selection.simulate on the live ledger rules (fills at the next open, 5 bp a side), the delisting-honest world, every window ending 2024-07-19 exclusive, $100 at the span start: 2006-2015 $302 (+11.7%/yr, SR 0.53, DD 63%) | 2016-2024 $660 (+24.6%/yr, SR 0.88, DD 33%) | pre-holdout 2006-2024 $1,994 (+17.5%/yr, SR 0.70, DD 63%) vs the clean line it replaced (6 / 60-40 / cap 2) $229 / $420 / $963 and SPY $203 / $316 / $640 (+7.3 / +14.3 / +10.5%/yr; SR 0.47 / 0.87 / 0.65; DD 55 / 32 / 55%). At the clean line's own settings the package reads $306 / $555 / $1,700 — the model carries the edge, the layers add ~1%/yr. 2016-2024 was read once, as registered: falsification test (the package's paired weekly excess over the incumbent, 446 weeks) t +1.32, not rejected; paired weekly t vs SPY +1.90 (2006-2024) / +1.52 (2016-2024). 95% CI on the excess CAGR vs SPY (seed / history bootstrap / nested): 2016-2024 point +9.0%/yr, +7.3..+10.5 / -3.9..+24.8 / -3.9..+24.2, P(excess>0) 0.91; 2006-2024 +6.5, +5.2..+7.6 / -2.1..+16.7 / -2.5..+16.2, 0.91; 2006-2015 +4.4, 0.76. Leak audit (ops/leak_audit.py): identity check PASS on both segments — the only gate since the owner's ruling of 2026-09-12 (a model may legitimately favour names that later split; the factor statistics are reported: select spearman -0.017, extend IC 0.035 t 4.0). Character: the picks' excess over the median member tracks the years high-volatility names win (2009 +4.6, 2020 +4.1 pp/4w) and gives it back in 2007-2008 (-2.8, -2.2); a 10-name uncapped book with no fixed ballast drew down 63% in 2008-2009. 2024-07-19+ holdout deliberately unspent. History (the clean line, champion 2026-09-11 -> 2026-09-12): Owner-declared champion after the 4-week rebuild campaign (AGENTS.md 9h and ledger r4w_*/r5pkg_* entries); supersedes ext-t20 weekly champion. Rebuilt 2026-09-09..11 after the split-leak audit (reports/nominal_basis_registration.md, reports/delisting_honest_verdict.md): the closeadj-basis level features and the split-restated SF1 per-share fields carried future splits, and the 2026-09-06 generated bundle was built on them (the leaky champion failed ops/leak_audit.py at retention 0.49). The champion is now the clean line — the panel's f_ columns on the nominal basis, no bundle. Strategy settings are the procedure's (strategy.settings_note; 60/40 since 2026-09-11 — at 60/40 on the same K=16 walk: 2006-2015 $229, SR 0.49, DD 52% | 2016-2024 $420, +18.2%/yr, SR 0.83, DD 38% | pre-holdout $963, +13.0%/yr, SR 0.65, DD 52%). Record at the 70/30 settings the line was switched under, K=16, selection.simulate on the live ledger rules (fills at the next open, 5 bp a side), every window ending 2024-07-19 exclusive: on the delisting-honest world (data/sharadar_world2000_nominal_dl, the live rules: last-print labels, traded-within-7-days universe; ledger nominal_clean_dl_k16) 2006-2015 $229 (+8.6%/yr, SR 0.46, DD 59%) | 2016-2024 $449 (+19.1%/yr, SR 0.80, DD 42%) | pre-holdout 2006-2024 $1,028 (+13.4%/yr, SR 0.62, DD 59%) vs SPY $197 / $316 / $621 (+7.0 / +14.3 / +10.3%/yr; SR 0.46 / 0.87 / 0.64; DD 55 / 32 / 55%); on the standing nominal world (labels dropped at a delisting; ledger nominal_clean_k16) $262 / $560 / $1,468. The two worlds' ensembles agree at Spearman 0.915 (seed-halves of one walk: 0.72); the difference is path noise: disjoint K=4 draws on 2016-2024 read $484-$676 (honest) and $481-$706 (standing), all above SPY, and 2006-2015 draws straddle SPY in both worlds — a 6-name book's terminal wealth carries a ~+/-30% band. Leak audit (ops/leak_audit.py, shifted-feature retention per segment) PASS on both segments. 95% CI (reports/clean_line_confidence.md; ledger nominal_clean_dl_ci95): excess CAGR vs SPY 2016-2024 point +4.2%/yr, seed-only +3.4..+8.5, history bootstrap -5.1..+14.2, nested -3.5..+16.3; pre-holdout point +2.8%/yr, nested -2.4..+10.6; paired weekly t 0.8 / 0.8; ~90% of resampled histories beat SPY. Contaminated-basis history for scale only (git history of this file, ledger champion_r5_7030_cap2_* and openfe_arm_v3_*): the old champion read $4,256 / $900 / $473 on the same spans — roughly half of its 2016-2024 SPY-relative edge was the split leak, the rest is the clean line above. 2024-07-19+ holdout deliberately unspent.

model.summary: simple-DT: depth-3 gbtree, untuned by design (config search measured as noise)

horizon.label: label_4w_sector
horizon.rationale: feature probe + population exams: month-ahead signal real (t>2), week-ahead dead since ~2004. Sector-centred target since 2026-09-12: stage C of the clean program (every week of 2006-2015, K=4) ranked label_4w_sector with an 8-year window first by the cascade's own book metric; the week-centred label_4w is the horizon's own label and the incumbent's. Written by stocks-ml procedure from the walk's record, never typed (procedure.model)

training_window_rationale: 8 years since 2026-09-12: the stage C argmax came as a package (sector label + 8-year window, ls_w8) — the 8-year window alone (win8) ranked below the incumbent at K=4 and failed the then-registered factor gate on a ratio of two zeros. Written by stocks-ml procedure from the walk's record (procedure.model). History: 5 years 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-12 (style-cycle whipsaw protection; robustness pick within noise band)

ensemble.k_copies_note: 16 since 2026-09-07 (4 from 2026-08-20): four disjoint K=4 draws of the then-champion graded $2,218-$3,498 over 2006-2024 and K=16 $4,256 (contaminated basis), so a K=4 record was one draw's luck on top of the model; the record is always the K=16 walk, with the K=4 draws quoted as the path band (clean line 2016-2024: $484-$676 honest, $481-$706 standing). selection.K_COPIES is pinned to this value by tests/test_r5.py
ensemble.method: WeekBootstrapEstimator: copy c = random_state c + whole-week bootstrap seeded by c; predictions averaged (replication.py)

strategy.weight: equal, re-leveled weekly (drift-threshold in live trading)
strategy.stop_action: none — audited 2026-09-01: stop measured mildly negative on dollars in the final configuration (as deployed, 2026-09-03: off $1,553 vs -25% $1,499, SR 0.72 vs 0.73, DD 62% vs 60%; close basis, fixed join: $1,644 vs $1,533, identical DD; before the rank-date fix, without the cap, $1,383 vs $1,296); removed for simplicity
strategy.sector_cap_note: No cap since 2026-09-12: on the stage E walk the cap lowered the Sharpe (.523 vs .532 without), so the procedure left it off; the live job's sleeves therefore hold whatever sectors rank. History of the 2-of-6 cap (2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-12): max 2 of 6 per sector; blocked slots go to next-ranked name from another sector (adopted 2026-09-01: +0.9%/yr and better SR in every window on the champion, no DD effect; re-graded on the fixed join +0.3 to +1.9%/yr per window, +1.2%/yr and SR 0.67 -> 0.72 over 2006-2024; as deployed (2026-09-03) +1.1%/yr and SR 0.67 -> 0.72 over 2006-2024, per window +2.1 / +0.5 / -0.1%/yr for 2006-12 / 2013-24 / 2021-24 with SR up or level in each)
strategy.settings_note: book_size, stop_loss, sector_cap, ballast.mix and the model fields (horizon.label, training_window_years) are written by `stocks-ml procedure` (stocks_ml.procedure: selection.decide_strategy on the K=16 walk of the selection window, the model from the walk's own record, see the `procedure` block) and never typed; tests/test_procedure.py fails on a hand edit of either the spec or the live job. 2026-09-12: run on the stage E walk (clean_program/stage_e/ls_w8/select), which wrote book 10 / halfgate / no stop / no cap and label_4w_sector / 8 years (changed from 6 / 60-40 / cap 2 and label_4w / 5 years). History: at the 2026-09-11 switch to the clean line the 70/30 floor was kept by hand while the cascade on the clean line's own 2006-2015 record (delisting-honest world) read 60/40 — a discretionary override against the mechanical rule, corrected the same day by running the procedure (book 6 / 60/40 / no stop / cap 2; floor Sharpe 60/40 0.438 vs 70/30 0.410). The stop_action and sector_cap_note figures are contaminated-basis history, kept for the reasoning.

ballast.mix: halfgate: book 100/83/67/50% of NAV by SPY trend gates down (30/40/52w), rest IEF
ballast.ballast_asset: IEF for the part of NAV the halfgate takes out of the book (no SPY ballast under halfgate; a fixed floor parks its ballast in SPY and shifts it to IEF per trend state)
ballast.trend_rule: three SPY trailing-MA gates (30/40/52 weeks), evaluated weekly, point-in-time; halfgate: book fraction 1 - g/6 for g gates breached (100/83/67/50%), the rest in IEF (ledger.floor_split, the one rule the backtest and the live job share). A fixed floor (60/40 etc.) instead keeps the book fraction and moves one third of the ballast SPY -> IEF per breached gate

panel: data/sharadar_world2000_nominal_dl/panel_sf.parquet (nominal basis, delisting-honest labels; price/volume + Sharadar fundamentals f_sf_* + insiders f_sfi_*; the screen's x_ candidates and any g_ columns ride along unused). Live: build_world_panel under config.yaml.
features_note: No bundle. The model's matrix is feature_cols (the panel's f_ columns: features/panel.py plus features/sharadar_fundamentals.py), research and live alike (walk.extra_features = []; r5.SPEC['features'] = features/bundle.py FEATURES = []). History: the screened ideas bundle (adopted 2026-09-05, asterisk: ideas written from the whole 2006-2024 record) and the generated bundle of 40 (adopted 2026-09-06, selected on 2006-2015 alone) were both built on split-leaky raw inputs and retired 2026-09-11; their nominal-basis replacement, screened under the same rule on 2006-2015 (ops/nominal_program.py screen), failed admission against the clean line at the cascade's own book (5.93 vs 8.14 %/yr, ledger nominal_program_verdict) and 2016-2024 read $522 vs the clean $560. A bundle re-enters only by passing the gate on 2006-2015 and the owner's go; the plumbing (generated.add_generated on bundle.FORMULAS) stays.

retune_policy.cadence: never on a calendar (nested experiment); structural triggers only
triggers: new data source / feature family passes the gate

honest_expectation: several %/yr over SPY in expectation (2016-2024 excess CAGR +9.0%/yr, 95% nested CI -3.9..+24.2; 2006-2024 +6.5%/yr, -2.5..+16.2), a band that still includes no edge; 60%+ drawdowns are on the record (2008-2009 at 10 names, no cap, halfgate at 50% book): capital preservation is not what this configuration buys; edge era-concentrated (years high-volatility names win: 2009, 2016, 2019-2021; index-matching in 2010-2015 and 2022-2024); pre-holdout numbers carry design-iteration shine — the label and window were chosen among ~15 candidates on 2006-2015 and 2016-2024 was read once; sizing should assume SPY-like outcomes in adverse regimes and a deeper hole than SPY's in a crash

selection_procedure.note: Mechanical cascade, run in this order on the selection window only; validated by the nested test (nested3_v1, 2026-09-04: select on every week of 2006-2015, grade 2016-2024; nested3_v2 re-ran it with the feature screen under rule v3.1, 2026-09-05; nested2_v1 was its sampled predecessor). Model config is NOT searched (simple-DT fixed; tuning measured as noise). Run programmatically: `stocks-ml select --sel-start A --sel-end B [--eval-start C --eval-end D] [--screen]` (stages cached & resumable under data/experiments/); the strategy layers (book, floor, stop, cap) that reach this spec are written by `stocks-ml procedure --preds <K=16 walk of the selection window>` (stocks_ml.procedure), the only path into strategy.* and ballast.mix. Since 2026-09-12 the procedure also writes the model fields (horizon.label, training_window_years) from the walk's own record (<walk>/spec.json recipe), so the spec's model is the walk that was graded, never typed; the label and window themselves were chosen by the clean-improvement program's stage C (reports/clean_improvement_registration.md), the row below.

steps.metric: cost-adjusted compounded return of the top-6 book (full population of the selection window)
top-6 edge vs random basket, paired on the weeks every window's population walk has (every week of the selection window since v3); all windows fully formed

steps.step: label x window x fit (clean program stage C, 2026-09-11)
steps.menu: stage B ranked 15 variants of the clean line on a 131-week sample (labels label_4w / label_4w_sector / gauss-rank, windows 3/5/8y, fixed 300 rounds, learning rate, depth, column and leaf settings); the four highest went to stage C on every week of 2006-2015 at K=4, plus their pairings (ls_w8 = sector label + 8y, ls_w8_f300)
steps.metric: top-6 cost-adjusted compounded %/yr on the common ranked weeks; argmax ls_w8 +7.57 (incumbent +5.44; paired t +0.95 reported); the winner's strategy layers then decided by stocks-ml procedure on its K=16 walk (stage E)

steps.menu: a candidate bundle over the nominal raw inputs (ops/nominal_program.py screen: generated formulas, or the x_ candidates of features/candidates.py)
steps.metric: screened on 2006-2015 alone; admitted iff the top-book cost-adjusted compounded return is higher with it than without at the cascade's own book (the paired HAC t reported, not the rule); every candidate passes ops/leak_audit.py per segment. No bundle is admitted as of 2026-09-11 (nominal screen 5.93 vs clean 8.14 %/yr)

selection_procedure.metric_convention: engine choices (horizon, window, book) by cost-adjusted compounded return; risk layers (floor, stop, cap) by Sharpe — owner-ratified 2026-09-01, 'for now'; earlier campaigns ranked by pre-tax earnings
selection_procedure.measured_selection_inflation: champion vs the nested honest-procedure pick on 2016-2024 (contaminated basis, 2026-09-04/05): clean $590 vs v3's $521, +1.9%/yr on dollars, ~0 on Sharpe. The deployed strategy layers are the cascade's own 2006-2015 argmax on the clean line since 2026-09-11 (strategy.settings_note); a nested re-measurement on the nominal world is a registered research item. Stage E (2026-09-12): the package chosen on 2006-2015 alone beat the incumbent on 2016-2024 by +6.4%/yr at the incumbent's settings ($555 vs $420) and +8.6%/yr at its own ($660); one read, as registered
selection_procedure.constraints: No layer reads a sample (v3, 2026-09-04), and no layer reads a rank week whose forward label ends after the window (`selection.label_end`: 35 days for 4w, 14 for 1w; 2026-09-05) — at a window ending at the holdout's edge those weeks would be graded on holdout prices. Selection on 2006-2015 only; 2016-01 -> 2024-07-12 is the one out-of-sample look, read once per registered candidate; the holdout never feeds selection. Every candidate passes ops/leak_audit.py on both segments before it is believed (the split leak, 2026-09-09). A bundle the screen admits is graded as a separate line beside the clean line, never in place of it; none is admitted as of 2026-09-11.

price_basis_note: config.yaml price_basis (Config.price_basis; env STOCKS_ML_PRICE_BASIS for research drivers): level features from closeunadj (what the tape showed) and the SF1 per-share ratios over the split-only adjusted close; returns and labels stay on closeadj. Adopted 2026-09-11 with the clean line. The live job's prices frame carries closeunadj/close_split from refresh_sharadar (prices_from_sep); build_world_panel refuses a nominal build without them.
delist_labels_note: config.yaml delist_labels (Config.delist_labels; env STOCKS_ML_DELIST_LABELS): a name whose series ends inside the label window grades to its final print — the live ledger's exit — instead of losing its label; the backtest universe uses live's traded-within-7-days rule (r5.rank_members). Adopted 2026-09-11 on the delisting-honest verdict (reports/delisting_honest_verdict.md): same strategy within the path band, matches what the Saturday job does with a delisting.

procedure.registration: selection_procedure (this file): book by cost-adjusted compounded %/yr; floor, stop, cap by Sharpe of the simulated weekly series, each at the picks above it; every layer reads every rank week of the selection window
